entities.summary: A mathematical framework for analyzing strategic interactions where the outcome for each participant depends on the choices of all. Developed by von Neumann and Morgenstern (1944), extended by Nash (1950), game theory revolutionized economics, political science, evolutionary biology, and military strategy.
